thread:
devon: Heads up — main CI is red after merging PR #2345 (lockfile updates). Failing integration tests for the http client. Suspect a transitive dep bump in poetry.lock.

maya: link to the failing job?

devon: https://ci.example.com/builds/98765 — job `linux-py39-integration` failed. Log excerpt:```
E       AssertionError: 200 != 500
tests/test_client_integration.py:42: AssertionError
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/httpx/_client.py", line 512, in post
    ...
TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'verify_tls'
```

ashley: ok let's try a rerun first. sometimes CI picked up an artifact.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by ashley — job 98765 rerun queued.

ci-bot: Rerun started (job 98766).

ci-bot: Rerun finished — status: failed. Same stack as above.

ryan: which commit introduced the lockfile change? can we bisect?

devon: commit a1b2c3d from PR #2345 included a refreshed poetry.lock (dependabot + manual pin). Short git log:```
commit a1b2c3d  (PR #2345)
Author: dependabot[bot]
Date:   Tue Mar 10 14:12:00 2026 +0000

    Bump httpx and httpcore

commit f4e5g6h  previous
```

maya: reproducing locally now:```
$ git checkout main && git pull
$ poetry install --no-dev
$ pytest tests/test_client_integration.py::test_post -q
F
==================================== FAILURES ====================================
________________________ test_post _________________________
    def test_post():
        resp = client.post(url, json={"x": 1})
>       assert resp.status_code == 200
E       AssertionError: 200 != 500
E       TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'verify_tls'
```
Confirmed same error locally.

ashley: so likely an API change in httpcore/httpx. Any quick workaround? pin to previous httpcore? revert lockfile?

ryan: two options: 1) revert the lockfile commit and open a small PR to keep CI green, or 2) explicitly pin transitive dependency in pyproject to the previous working version and update lock. Revert is fastest.

maya: I inspected the lock diff — httpcore went 0.16.2 -> 0.17.0 and httpx 0.23.x -> 0.24.0. Release notes for httpcore 0.17 mention handshake changes. Looks like our wrapper passed `verify_tls` kw that was removed.

devon: I'm going to open a revert PR that removes the lockfile update and pins httpcore to 0.16.2 in pyproject.toml as a short-term fix. Will mark it urgent/ci.

ashley: +1. Also add a test skip or compatibility shim in the client if needed. But revert first.

ryan: can you include a short postmortem comment in the PR explaining why we don't accept lockfile-only PRs without an owner? Might help avoid repeated breakage.

devon: yep will add that. Draft commands I ran while testing:```
# reproduce
poetry install --no-dev
pytest -q tests/test_client_integration.py::test_post
# quick pin (local test)
poetry add --lock httpcore@0.16.2
poetry lock --no-update
```

ci-bot: Created revert PR #2350 by devon — status: open. CI will run when ready.

devon: pinging @maya @ashley for review on #2350. I'm also going to revert the merge on main if CI doesn't go green quickly.

maya: reviewing now. If #2350 passes CI we can merge and then follow up with a proper upgrade plan for httpx/httpcore.

ashley: thanks — great quick triage. :thumbsup:

ryan: once merged, we should add a small CI gate that flags lockfile-only PRs in the future (or require an owner). I'll open a follow-up infra task.

devon: agreed. I'll add infra task to backlog and link it in PR. Reassigning to the oncall for follow-up if anything else pops up.

maiden: (bot noise) — no further failures reported after rerun of dependent jobs.

devon: closing loop here: #2350 merged, main CI turned green after revert. We'll schedule a proper upgrade with a compatibility shim and more integration tests. Thanks all. :rocket:
